Interface Metric

All Known Implementing Classes:
MetricJson
public interface Metric
A time-series metric returned by the Equinix Fabric Metrics API. Each metric describes a named measurement (for example bandwidth usage) for a particular asset over a series of time-bucketed datapoints.

Metrics supersede the deprecated per-asset /stats statistics endpoints and are retrieved via fabric.metrics().search(...) or the per-asset convenience methods fabric.connections().getMetrics(...) and fabric.ports().getMetrics(...).

ianjones
